notes: Edit the content where it is: right-click a portal and choose "Edit … content". The panel goes into edit mode on your desktop, you click the card you want, and its pieces become draggable in place — at the real size, on the real wallpaper…

⚠️ The starting point is the card itself. A card with no design of its own is READ INTO ONE when you click it — every reading it draws, in its own columns, at its own sizes — so the default is exactly what the panel already shows and the…

This replaces designing against a preview. The preview was a second card, and every stubborn fault traced to the two disagreeing: hand-written starter tables drifting from the layout the panel computes (defaults that collided and dropped…
Editing is in the shared design host, so a tweak on the desktop is the same design object the Content Designer saves and every portal draws — what you tweak is what ships.
